mechanics.name: Open-Handed
mechanics.currentEffect: All Survivors benefit from a permanent increase of 8/12/16 metres to the radius of Aura-reading abilities. Open-Handed only affects Auras that emanate from the Survivor causing them, and a Survivor can be affected by only one instance of Open-Handed at a time.
activation: The perk is equipped; the Aura-reading radius modifier is always active.
Ends/deactivates when: The effect ends with the Trial or if the perk is no longer active.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (4.7.0): Increased the Aura-reading radius bonus to 8/12/16 metres and made it non-stacking.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: It increases the range of Aura-reading abilities for all Survivors by the equipped user's tier value.
duration: Permanent for the Trial while equipped.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: A Survivor can be affected by only one instance of Open-Handed at a time.
specialInteractions: Only increases range for Aura-reading abilities that emanate from the Survivor causing them; it does not extend Auras generated by other sources.
Multiple Open-Handed copies do not stack on a Survivor.

editorial.summary: Increase the radius of qualifying Survivor Aura-reading effects by up to 16 metres for the whole team.
useCases: Extend Kindred's local Killer-read radius around a hook.
Increase the reach of Bond and other range-based Survivor Aura effects.
Support an entire team's Aura builds from one perk slot.
counters: Does nothing for Aura effects that are not range-based in the supported way.
Only one Open-Handed effect can benefit a Survivor at a time.
Very weak in a build with no compatible Aura perks.
pros: Sixteen metres is a large range increase.
Exceptional synergy with some already-good information perks.
analysis: Open-Handed takes this position because sixteen extra metres can meaningfully change several Aura perks. Kindred is the famous example: expanding the local Killer-read area around a hook can expose movement that would otherwise fall just outside the normal radius.
The teamwide nature is important. One copy can strengthen compatible Aura reading for every Survivor, allowing coordinated teams to build around the effect without spending four perk slots on it.

The weakness is absolute dependency on synergy. Open-Handed does nothing useful by itself, and not every Aura effect can be extended. A player who equips it without compatible perks has effectively surrendered a slot.
That makes it a strong build multiplier rather than a strong standalone perk. With the right information package it can outperform this rank; without one, it belongs near the bottom of the list.
editorial.verdict: One of the better pure synergy perks. Open-Handed can supercharge strong Aura builds, but it has essentially no independent floor.
